article.story: TEANECK, N.J. -- — Taeshaud Jackson scored 22 points as Fairleigh Dickinson beat Saint Francis 66-59 on Thursday night. Jackson also contributed 12 rebounds for the Knights (10-16, 7-6 Northeast Conference). Joey Niesman scored 14 points, shooting 4 for 11 (2 for 7 from 3-point range) and 4 of 10 from the free-throw line. Chris Moncrief finished with 14 points for the Red Flash (6-19, 4-8). Gestin Liberis added 13 points, seven rebounds and two steals for Saint Francis. Skylar Wicks finished with 11 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
